name: cloud.storage_find
description: List configured cloud drives for which you have an account. Use the returned service_id for file operations. Connections and credentials are resolved by the tools.

name: cloud.file_upload
description: Upload a file of at most 256 KiB to your cloud drive through WebDAV. Supply base64-encoded content and an absolute file path whose parent folder already exists. An existing file at that path is replaced.

name: cloud.file_download
description: Download a file of at most 256 KiB from your cloud drive through WebDAV. Returns base64 content, byte count and SHA-256. Use the file's absolute path in your own drive.

name: cloud.file_share
description: Share a file in your cloud drive with an existing user on the same drive. Supply the recipient's cloud username, not their display name. Only read permission is supported.
